提示词优化说明：
不使用可关闭
使用时请正确选择H3生成模式

基础设置
分辨率 | 时长 | 基础提示词

使用建议
不开二采
关闭二阶段采样，分辨率选择器选 0.9，直接渲染 720p 视频。

使用建议
开启二采
一采分辨率必须降低（推荐 0.4），保证低消耗快速跑完。
二采时再将分辨率拉高，配合较低步数进行精修。
二采分辨率视硬件性能而定，过高会严重影响速度。
实操流程（本地推荐）
先关二采 → 单采抽卡 → 满意后锁定 Seed → 再开二采强化细节，避免前期浪费算力。

参考素材设置区
所有素材（图 + 视频 + 音频）混合输入时，总数不得超过‌12 个‌！！
1. 参考图像最多接入9张图像（这里加载6个输入框）
2. 音频最多‌支持3 段，需与图像或视频搭配（总时长不超 15 秒，用于设置节奏、对白或环境声）
3. 视频最多‌支持3 段视频‌每段 2-15 秒（总时长不超过 15 秒，用于定义运镜风格或动作逻辑）

subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the white and blue battle-worn humanoid robot (Gundam-style) with visible panel lines, red hydraulic tubes, and shoulder thrusters, abstracted from <Picture 1>.
<Subject 2> is the massive, muscular Tyrannosaurus Rex with textured grey-green skin and sharp teeth, abstracted from <Picture 2>.
<Subject 3> is the dense, humid tropical rainforest environment with towering ferns and dappled sunlight, abstracted from <Picture 3>.

summary:

retention_analysis:

<Subject 2>: fully_preserved
<Subject 3>: fully_preserved

detailed_description:
The video features a high-contrast cinematic action sequence blending sci-fi mecha aesthetics with realistic CGI dinosaur visuals in a lush natural setting.

[Shot 1] At 00:00.000
The scene opens in <Subject 3>, a dense rainforest. <Subject 1> stands amidst the towering ferns, its white and blue armor contrasting with the green foliage. The camera tracks slightly forward as <Subject 2> bursts from the underbrush behind the robot, roaring with its mouth wide open. <Subject 1> turns its torso rapidly to face the threat. (S1) <d>中文 注意！</d>

[Shot 2] At 00:02.000
<Subject 2> lunges forward, snapping its jaws. <Subject 1> sidesteps with heavy mechanical footsteps, raising its right arm to block the impact. The camera shakes slightly to emphasize the collision. The dinosaur's claws scrape against the robot's armor. (S1) <d>中文 核心反应炉稳定！</d>

[Shot 3] At 00:04.000
<Subject 1> stabilizes its footing and thrusts its fist forward, striking <Subject 2> in the snout. The dinosaur recoils, shaking its head. The camera zooms in slightly on the robot's cockpit area as the dust settles. (S1) <d>中文 目标压制成功！</d>

overall_soundscape:
Dense rainforest ambience with distant bird calls. Heavy mechanical servo whirring and hydraulic hissing from the robot. Deep, guttural roars and heavy thuds from the dinosaur. The metallic screech of claws on armor during the clash.
